records.title: Item registry slot 50 guarded source bytes
records.summary: For the canonical executable target, item slot 50 is identified at RVA 0x005C4CE8 / VA 0x1405C4CE8 and the guarded source bytes are 00 01 08 13. The physical file offset must be resolved through the parsed PE sections.

locations.note: Guard bytes: 00 01 08 13. Any patch must verify the artifact SHA-256, resolve the RVA through the parsed PE sections, and verify these exact bytes before modification.

records.title: Game-verified item ID observations
records.summary: Runtime tests confirmed red orb IDs 1-3, green orb IDs 9-11, white orb IDs 12-14, star ID 17, and holy water ID 19 in the tested DMC3 HD build and workflows.

locations.note: Evidence source is reproducible game testing rather than one isolated executable region. Non-orb items may depend on event-based spawn or collection behavior.

records.title: Inventory limit immediate-comparison patch family
records.summary: Historical reverse-engineering identified six inventory-limit comparison sites using the 83 F8 imm8 pattern. The established guarded implementation supports values 1-127 directly, treats 128-255 as a separate controlled range, and blocks 256 or greater.

locations.note: The six exact public locations still require migration into a dedicated location-complete Evidence Packet before production patch generation.
